message.content:
The 19th‑century sculpture that is most frequently cited as the era’s iconic masterpiece is **Auguste Rodin’s “The Thinker”** (originally part of his monumental work *The Gates of Hell*, completed in 1902). Although it was finished just after the century ended, its conception began in the 1880s and it quickly became emblematic of modern sculpture.  

If you’re looking for a piece that was created entirely within the 1800s, Rodin’s **“The Kiss”** (1889) is another landmark work that captured the public imagination and remains one of the most celebrated sculptures of the 19th century.
